title: Trees in the wind
changes: Every tree, bush and patch of tall grass has been rebuilt in the new 3D-crafted style: leafy oaks, autumn and sickly trees, dark pines, desert palms, weeping willows, ferns, gorse, thorn scrub and dead trees.
A gentle wind now runs through the lands: gusts roll across the woods in waves, bending crowns, palm fronds, willow curtains and grass as they pass.
The new trees are drawn once and only switch poses in the wind, so they cost less than the old ones.
